# Fundraising

Everything the club does to raise money beyond fees: grants, sponsorship, events, appeals and donations. The biggest effort right now is the [[match-funding]] for the new changing rooms.

## What sits here

- The £63,000 match funding and how it splits: [[match-funding]], [[match-funding-appeal]], [[club-budget-2026-27]].
- Sponsorship: [[sponsorship-overview]], [[coyle-motors-sponsorship-agreement]], [[brian-coyle]].
- Events that raise money: the summer tournament ([[summer-tournament-2026]]).
- Grants: the Lanternfield Trust application under [[changing-rooms-grant-application]] and the Draymoor Community Chest award.
- General reading on fundraising and matching funds, filed as Sources.

## How we think about it

Fees pay for football and athletics; fundraising pays for things that last longer than a season. I try to keep the two apart in our papers, because members accept a fee rise more easily when they can see which part goes to running costs and which to the building. The March 2026 fee rise blurred that line a little, and Ravinder was right to say so ([[board-meeting-2026-03-10]]).
